content.short: fuzzlib is an unopinionated Solidity fuzzing library for stateful and stateless fuzzing of smart contracts.
content.description: fuzzlib is an unopinionated Solidity library designed to support both stateful and stateless fuzzing of smart contracts. It bundles a suite of practical utilities and libraries that streamline fuzzing harness development for Echidna, Medusa, and Foundry, helping developers create tests more efficiently and with greater ease. By providing ready-to-use building blocks, fuzzlib reduces boilerplate and accelerates the process of exploring contract behavior under varied inputs and conditions.

resources.title: What an Invariant Actually Is
resources.tldr: A condition that must hold in every state. Getting that statement right is most of the work; the fuzzer just hunts for exceptions.
